annotations.title: chainpeek: deployed bytecode size, hash, minimal-proxy and EIP-7702 detection of an address

description: chainpeek: Get the deployed bytecode size and hash of an address, with EIP-1167 and EIP-7702 detection. For other proxy kinds use detect_proxy. Returns what is deployed at an address. Only EIP-1167 clones and EIP-7702 delegations are detected. A delegated wallet is not a contract. Ethereum, Base and Robinhood only. Read-only. A bad address is a 422 (not charged). Typically under 1 s. Price: USD 0.001. Free: 10 chain reads per IP per UTC day. Docs: https://tanod.dev/learn/ethereum-rpc-reads-api.html
